title: push-00 L106: chatPush replaces Message StateChange?
description: crate-jmap reads push-00 L106 as: for an account with live chatPush, Message is dropped from that account's StateChange (D10), so Message edits/deletes are not pushed via StateChange. Clarify whether chatPush replaces or supplements Message StateChange, and how edits/deletes reach push clients. Raised by crate-jmap JMAP-nbk3 plan (approved 2026-10-19).
